newsitem.title: UK: Ldn freight - BFI down 13 points, market quiet.
newsitem.headline: Ldn freight - BFI down 13 points, market quiet.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index fell 13 points to 1,332, as the key U.S. Gulf/Japan grain route rate slipped.
The U.S. Gulf/Japan route was fixed at $21.50 basis no combination ports by MBK on two unnamed Choyang vessels, which are to carry 54,000 tonnes of heavy grain each.
This rate was down 50 cents on last reported for a May shipment.
"Its a very quiet market, the U.S. Gulf/Japan rate may look a little softer but that's for a July shipment," one broker said.
"The U.S. Gulf/Japan grain route for a prompt shipment date looks to be holding steady at the moment," said another.
The coal and ore sector for capesize vessels was very quiet. The only fresh fixing in this area was Cobam's fixing of 140,000 tonnes ore Ponta do Ubu/Rotterdam 15-30/5 at $6.
The BIFFEX futures closed five to 30 points down. Most active May traded last at 1,315, down 30. May traded volume was 63 lots, while the total volume was 120 lots.
Fresh timecharter capesize fixing was absent, with panamax business fairing only slightly better, brokers said.
Amongst the panamax trade, was Pan Ocean's taking of the Ever Praise 63,195 dwt del Keelung prompt trip via Australia redel Egyptian Mediterranean at $6,500 daily.
